create_sky_compat.configuration.title: Create Sky Compat
create_sky_compat.config.minimumGap.tool: Minimum horizontal distance from the full village footprint to island terrain, in block columns. Overlap is always rejected.
create_sky_compat.config.maximumGap.tool: Maximum distance to a sampled host island. Must be at least the minimum terrain gap.
create_sky_compat.config.minimumIslandRa: Minimum native radius of the host island. This does not change island generation.
create_sky_compat.journal.images_descrip: Show the entry icon and authored item images beside conditions and rewards.
create_sky_compat.journal.symbols_descri: Show small visual marks beside condition types. Written requirements remain visible.
create_sky_compat.journal.notifications_: Announce first objective progress and completion. Unlocking an entry does not send a notice.
create_sky_compat.journal.images.tooltip: Show the entry icon and authored item images beside conditions and rewards.
create_sky_compat.journal.symbols.toolti: Show small visual marks beside condition types. Written requirements remain visible.
Announce first objective progress and completion. Unlocking an entry does not send a notice.
create_sky_compat.configuration.local_sc: This process only; remote server settings are not shown.
create_sky_compat.configuration.startup_: Startup switches. Restart the whole game/server after editing. Missing targets remain inactive; omitted keys use their defaults. Generation-related choices are guarded by saved world identity.
create_sky_compat.configuration.village_: Local common village tuning. Captured when a local server starts; it does not configure a remote server. Existing structures remain unchanged. Available only with the village adaptation.
create_sky_compat.configuration.terrain_: Terrain tuning for Create Sky Islands. Restart after editing and use a fresh world for changed generation. Client and server files must agree; saved identity rejects incompatible changes. Available only with the preset adaptation.
create_sky_compat.configuration.bluemap_: Dedicated-server viewer settings. Requires BlueMap and Sky Archipelago, plus explicit map selection. Run bluemap reload after edits; browsers refresh within 30 seconds. Does not configure BlueMap network access or generate tiles.
create_sky_compat.configuration.journal_: Client presentation only. Edit through Journal Settings or the registered client config. Changes apply without restart; remote players keep their own preferences.
create_sky_compat.configuration.no_regis: No registered settings are active. See Adaptation status for the dependency and startup selections.
